Defect Name: Search returns duplicate itineraries
Defect Description: Round-trip search can return the same itinerary twice when fare families differ only in internal pricing identifiers.

Defect Name: Nonstop filter includes connecting flight
Defect Description: Applying the nonstop filter can leave an itinerary containing a technical connection.

Defect Name: Traveler profile loses phone country code
Defect Description: Saving an updated traveler profile can drop the phone country code and cause notification delivery failures.

Defect Name: Passport expiration validation accepts expired document
Defect Description: International traveler validation incorrectly accepts an already expired passport for some date formats.

Defect Name: Payment retry creates duplicate authorization
Defect Description: A retry after a payment timeout can create a second card authorization instead of reusing the original transaction state.

Defect Name: Payment failure message hides decline reason
Defect Description: Checkout returns a generic error when the payment provider supplies a customer-actionable decline category.

Defect Name: Retry button remains disabled after recoverable failure
Defect Description: The payment retry control does not become available after a recoverable gateway timeout.

Defect Name: Booking receipt shows incorrect tax total
Defect Description: The confirmation receipt can display an incorrect tax subtotal when multiple passenger types are present.

Defect Name: Seat map displays occupied seat as available
Defect Description: Seat availability can become stale and show an already assigned seat as selectable.

Defect Name: Extra-legroom seat price not refreshed
Defect Description: Premium seat pricing is not refreshed after itinerary repricing and can show an outdated amount.

Defect Name: Check-in eligibility ignores document restriction
Defect Description: Online check-in can be offered even when an international document check requires airport verification.

Defect Name: Checked-in status not persisted after refresh
Defect Description: A successful check-in can appear incomplete after the itinerary page is refreshed.

Defect Name: Boarding pass barcode fails scanner validation
Defect Description: Generated boarding-pass barcode contains an invalid segment sequence for a subset of connecting itineraries.

Defect Name: Prepaid baggage quantity exceeds allowance
Defect Description: The baggage purchase flow allows more checked bags than the configured itinerary maximum.

Defect Name: Transferred bag event displayed out of order
Defect Description: Baggage tracking can display a transfer event before the bag-loaded event due to event timestamp handling.

Defect Name: Delayed baggage notification sent twice
Defect Description: A delayed-bag event can trigger duplicate push notifications when the same operational event is replayed.

Defect Name: Flight delay status not refreshed
Defect Description: Flight status can remain on-time after an operational delay event has been received.

Defect Name: Gate change SMS uses previous gate
Defect Description: The SMS notification template can contain the old gate while the app displays the new gate.

Defect Name: Cancelled itinerary not detected for rebooking
Defect Description: A cancellation event on the first segment is not always marked as a disrupted itinerary.

Defect Name: Alternate flight ranking prefers later arrival
Defect Description: Recovery search can rank a later-arriving alternate above an earlier valid option.

Defect Name: Rebooking confirmation retains cancelled segment
Defect Description: After self-service rebooking, the confirmation can still display the cancelled flight segment.

Defect Name: Refund calculation includes nonrefundable seat fee
Defect Description: Cancellation refund calculation incorrectly includes a nonrefundable premium seat fee.

Defect Name: Refund submitted twice after client retry
Defect Description: A client retry after a timeout can submit the same refund request more than once.

Defect Name: Refund completion email not sent
Defect Description: Refund status reaches completed but the customer notification is not generated.

Defect Name: Reward redemption balance not updated
Defect Description: After points are redeemed, the displayed loyalty balance can remain unchanged until the next login.

Defect Name: Expired travel credit accepted
Defect Description: Checkout can accept a travel credit that expired earlier on the same calendar day in another timezone.

Defect Name: Voucher can be redeemed concurrently
Defect Description: Concurrent checkout requests can consume the same promotional voucher more than once.

Defect Name: Wheelchair request missing from itinerary
Defect Description: A saved wheelchair assistance request does not appear in the final itinerary summary.

Defect Name: Multi-city search drops third segment
Defect Description: A three-leg multi-city itinerary can omit the third segment after fare repricing.

Defect Name: Passport validation rejects valid leap-day expiry
Defect Description: A valid passport expiry date on February 29 is rejected by document validation.

Defect Name: Booking lookup fails for hyphenated surname
Defect Description: Manage booking cannot retrieve some reservations when the traveler surname contains a hyphen.

Defect Name: Fare difference rounded incorrectly
Defect Description: Changing an itinerary can round the fare difference incorrectly for currencies without two decimal minor units.

Defect Name: Final boarding call sent after boarding closed
Defect Description: Final-call notification can be delivered after the flight boarding status has already changed to closed.

Defect Name: Recommendation shown despite personalization opt-out
Defect Description: A personalized ancillary recommendation can appear for a customer who disabled personalization.

Defect Name: Fare alert triggered by insignificant price change
Defect Description: Fare monitoring sends an alert for a price movement below the customer's configured threshold.

Defect Name: Booking failure alert lacks correlation ID
Defect Description: Critical booking alerts do not include the transaction correlation identifier required for rapid incident diagnosis.
